summary: Examines how the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) can identify the user-level service that a call is being used for. It discusses why this is useful, lays out architectural principles, warns of problems when done poorly such as fraud and interoperability failures, and recommends good practices. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When a phone call arrives, how does the system know if it's a voice call, a video chat, or something else? This explains how to tell, and what goes wrong if you guess.

questions: how to identify communication services in sip
